answer_4.quote: We recruited 33 real users to interact with different agents in three tasks ... At the end of the conversation, ... users to evaluate the naturalness, coherence, and task completion ability of the agent with a score of 1 to 5.
answer_4.guideline: Human participants rated each dialogue system on naturalness, coherence, and task‑completion ability using a 1‑to‑5 Likert scale.
